spread_evidence.classification: OBSERVED — M1 BAR-MINIMUM SPREAD, NOT POINT-IN-TIME EXECUTABLE SPREAD
spread_evidence.cutoff_rule: Only normalized M1 timestamps strictly before 2026-03-01T23:00:00Z are included; no post-cutoff/directional-window data is used.

endpoint_audit.classification: DESCRIPTIVE INTERVAL EVIDENCE ONLY — NOT EXECUTION-TIME OR EXECUTABLE SPREAD
endpoint_audit.rule: Exact prior normalized M1 bar at execution_timestamp - 60000 only; same timestamp is the following interval and prohibited; gaps remain missing with no imputation.

spread_evidence.limitation: No bid/ask levels, quote time, or fill. The minimum is a lower-bound bar statistic and can understate execution spread; it is never applied as a broker cost.

swap_financing.reason: No historical swap mode/rates/rollover3days or sanitized DEAL_SWAP history; current rates are not backfilled.
